title: Artifact for From Tool Invocation to Source-Mechanism Exploration: Protected White-Box DSE for Open-Source EDA
description: Artifact Evaluation repository for 'From Tool Invocation to Source-Mechanism Exploration: Protected White-Box DSE for Open-Source EDA'. Provides pinned EDA setup, fresh Table 4--6 experiment runners, retained Table 5 legalizer snapshots, 18 selected ReviewDSE source programs, ReviewDSE search scripts, figure generation, and numerical evaluation.

creators.name: Wang, Ziyi
creators.affiliation: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

notes: A clean OpenROAD-flow-scripts workspace can be prepared with make bootstrap at the revisions recorded in provenance/source-commits.json. The paper run used a Teacher and four Student agents for 10 review iterations. Table 5 reuses three checksummed LEGALM, Diamond, and Negotiation source snapshots and regenerates its inputs with local utilization values 70, 90, and 60.
